analysis:
## Technical analysis

**Morning setup (11:15 UTC, US not yet open):** Prior close $152.91 (June 25). Bond distribution Day 4 (formal settlement today). KOSPI −5.81% premarket risk-off. Russell Reconstitution SPCX Russell 1000 addition at 4 PM ET.

**$150 IG floor (CRITICAL):** Three consecutive intraday tests (June 23: $147.11 all-time low; June 24: $150.72; June 25: $150.00 exact). Zero closing breaches. Fourth test likely today on KOSPI risk-off. Narrowing close margin ($154.54 → $152.91) increases closing breach risk.

**Distribution signature:** Pattern has repeated three consecutive sessions — NQ/AI risk-on drives intraday spike to $158–$161, distribution supply closes SPCX below prior session. June 25 was the strongest possible bid (NQ +2.1%) and still closed −1.05%. The mechanics are systematic.

**Re-entry framework:** (1) Two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. (2) Bond distribution clearance (~July 7–10 after formal June 26 settlement) is prerequisite. (3) September 2 first earnings is the structural catalyst. (4) Russell Reconstitution today does NOT unlock re-entry.
